learning_outcomes.text: Performs kinematic analysis for moving particles and rigid bodies.
Applies kinetic (dynamic equilibrium) principles for moving particles and rigid bodies.
Applies work and energy methods for moving bodies.
Applies impulse and momentum principles for moving bodies.
